summary: 过去 24 小时 AI 新闻按技术、模型、商业、投资、安全与监管聚合。页面优先展示影响力高、来源清晰、并且能解释后续产业意义的信号。

keylines.title: 商业是今日主轴
keylines.text: 过去 24 小时里，商业相关内容占比最高，说明媒体报道和社交讨论正在向这一方向集中。

keylines.title: Grok / xAI带动 X 讨论
keylines.text: X 热点更偏实时体验和争议观点，适合用来捕捉模型、产品和安全事件的早期信号。

keylines.title: 基础设施仍是深层变量
keylines.text: 芯片、数据中心、电力和推理成本会持续决定 AI 产品能否从发布会走向规模化商业。

stories.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
stories.summary: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.
stories.analysis: 模型托管关系会牵动算力、商业竞争和数据控制权，供应方承诺之外还要看合同约束与平台中立性。

stories.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
stories.summary: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.
stories.analysis: 版权诉讼的焦点正在从训练原则转向证据、数据集和输出归因，这会直接影响模型公司的合规成本与数据策略。

stories.title: The Hugging Face hack could indicate cultural issues at OpenAI
stories.summary: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here.
stories.analysis: 安全与真实性议题正在从原则讨论进入可执行工具，媒体、平台和企业需要更快识别合成内容与自动化攻击。

stories.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
stories.summary: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于商业化信号，后续重点是它是否进入高频工作流，并形成稳定付费或留存。

stories.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
stories.summary: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.
stories.analysis: 芯片、模型套件和 Agent 编排框架一起出现时，重点不是单点性能，而是端到端推理成本、部署效率和生态绑定。

stories.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
stories.summary: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻更像模型供应链信号：OpenAI 与 Microsoft 的产品绑定会影响企业办公入口、模型议价权和未来替换成本。

stories.title: Debian won’t ban AI code from its Linux distribution
stories.summary: Debian voted to allow developers to use AI tools in their contributions to the Linux distribution's "development, maintenance, [and] documentation.
stories.analysis: AI 编程工具竞争正在进入大型迁移和多步骤修复场景，差异会体现在代码库理解、权限控制和可审计输出。

stories.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
stories.summary: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.
stories.analysis: 用自家 Agent 完成融资是强营销信号，但真正的验证在于企业客户是否愿意把高价值流程交给同类自动化系统。

stories.title: ChatGPT to face tougher regulation in the EU
stories.summary: OpenAI will soon be held accountable for mitigating risks related to ChatGPT's impact on minors, user mental health, and the spread of illegal content in the European Union.
stories.analysis: 政府、国安和监管相关内容会影响模型公司的销售边界、合规成本和跨境可用性。

stories.title: Polimill builds Japan's next-generation public AI infrastructure
stories.summary: Polimill uses OpenAI GPT models and Codex to help municipalities search and use administrative knowledge while accelerating development.
stories.analysis: AI 编程工具竞争正在进入大型迁移和多步骤修复场景，差异会体现在代码库理解、权限控制和可审计输出。

stories.title: New York Governor Kathy Hochul thinks AI should be ‘less evil’
stories.summary: Today, I’m talking with New York Governor Kathy Hochul, and I’ll just warn you — this episode moves really fast.
stories.analysis: 政府、国安和监管相关内容会影响模型公司的销售边界、合规成本和跨境可用性。

stories.title: Instagram cracks down on AI accounts pretending to be human
stories.summary: Instagram is finally taking steps to address the rise of fake AI-influencer accounts that have gotten harder to spot.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于商业化信号，后续重点是它是否进入高频工作流，并形成稳定付费或留存。

stories.title: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
stories.summary: As backlash grows over Flock's AI surveillance cameras, Texas Governor Greg Abbott has frozen state spending on them.
stories.analysis: 资本与基础设施信号要和现金流、电力、算力利用率一起看，热度本身不等于可持续商业回报。

stories.title: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
stories.summary: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell have filed suit against Anthropic in the US District Court for the Northern District of California seeking damages for "tens of thousands" copyrighted works.
stories.analysis: 版权诉讼的焦点正在从训练原则转向证据、数据集和输出归因，这会直接影响模型公司的合规成本与数据策略。

xTrends.signal: 模型能力、价格和开发者可用性是主要讨论点，很多帖子直接拿它和 OpenAI、Anthropic 对比。
讨论集中在新模型分层、企业访问节奏、推理质量和产品体验是否有实质提升。
安全研究者和 CISO 圈层关注 AI Agent 是否会把攻击链自动化到新的速度。
投资者讨论长期数据中心租约、电力容量和 AI 基建股是否进入过热区间。
手机厂商把 AI 拉回端侧入口之争，争议点是功能是否真能改变日常使用。
创作者圈层继续测试视频生成、图像模型和工作流自动化，版权与真实性问题伴随升温。

briefings.title: 从热度看真实优先级
briefings.text: 模型发布仍最容易引爆讨论，但企业最终会按稳定性、成本、权限集成和数据安全来选择供应商。

briefings.title: 安全窗口继续缩短
briefings.text: AI Agent 让攻击链更自动化，防守重点需要前移到身份、权限、工具调用和数据访问异常。

briefings.title: 资本开支影响模型竞争
briefings.text: 算力合同、芯片供应和数据中心成本正在成为 AI 公司竞争力的一部分。

watchlist: OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、NVIDIA、xAI 是否发布新的 API、价格或企业访问策略
X 高热讨论是否被主流媒体确认，还是停留在圈层争议
AI 数据中心和芯片供应是否出现新的融资、电力或交付约束
监管机构是否把 AI 安全、版权、金融建议或出口限制推进到执法层面
